facts.name: cc
facts.doc: major * 100 + minor * 10, e.g. 900

facts.name: regs_per_sm
facts.doc: registers one SM holds

facts.name: smem_per_sm
facts.doc: cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerMultiprocessor

facts.name: smem_per_cta_optin
facts.doc: cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin: the opt-in dynamic maximum of one CTA

facts.name: max_threads_per_sm
facts.doc: resident threads one SM holds

facts.name: sm_count
facts.doc: prop.multiProcessorCount: the streaming multiprocessors of the device (a slice reports its own)

facts.name: tensor
facts.doc: the tensor-core instruction kinds the device issues

facts.name: instructions
facts.doc: the instruction capabilities kernels select code on (common/hardware.json's INSTRUCTION caps)

facts.name: d_v
facts.doc: the value width of the call's state

facts.name: levels
facts.doc: the depth of the call's hierarchy (decode's D)

facts.name: decay
facts.doc: whether the call's recurrence decays

facts.name: prefill
facts.doc: 0 for a decode step, 1 for a prefill: the call's kind, and with it the family that serves it

facts.name: tokens
facts.doc: the call's sequence length T (a decode step: 1)

facts.name: batch_heads
facts.doc: B times H, the call's independent streams: the extent the kernels' queues and grids are sized by

facts.name: stateful
facts.doc: 1 when a state is handed in or out of the call

facts.name: width_bits_1
facts.unit: log2 of a level's width (0: the call has no such level)
facts.doc: the log2 of level 1's width: a level's width is a power of two (fsla/_state.py StateFormat), so a range states every width exactly; 0 for a level beyond the call's `levels`

facts.name: read_listed_1
facts.unit: 0 or 1 (0: every digit is walked, or the call has no such level)
facts.doc: 1 when the read side of level 1 is WALKED BY ITS LISTS, 0 when every digit of it is walked (an action, never a property of the data: a wrong walk costs time and never the result). The producer's rule chooses it from the declaration (fsla.ops.produce.activation_walks: a side whose activation has exact zeros is walked by its lists); 0 for a level beyond the call's `levels`
